title: Parkio Daily for November 21, 2026
teaser: Pirates of the Caribbean closes most of 2027 at Magic Kingdom; EPCOT Festival of the Arts dates set for Jan 15–March 1; Christmas week prices hit new highs.

bignews.title: Pirates of the Caribbean closing for year-long refurbishment in 2027
bignews.body: Magic Kingdom will close Pirates of the Caribbean for most of 2027 for a major refurbishment adding new effects and what Disney calls new magic. The attraction will shut down in early 2027 and remain closed through most of the year.

parkioInsight.text: Adventureland may see heavier traffic in early 2026 as guests try to ride before closure. Jungle Cruise and Haunted Mansion tend to absorb displaced crowds once work begins.

bignews.title: EPCOT Festival of the Arts returns January 15 through March 1
bignews.body: The 2027 EPCOT International Festival of the Arts will run from January 15 through March 1, featuring visual artists, culinary offerings, and performing arts experiences. Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game returns as presenting sponsor.

parkioInsight.text: Early festival weeks in mid-January usually see lighter crowds than February school breaks. Weekdays before Presidents Day tend to offer shorter lines and easier access to artist meet-and-greets.

bignews.title: Disney World raises Christmas week ticket prices to new peak levels
bignews.body: Single-day tickets for late December 2026 have climbed to new highs, with Disney also introducing a discounted three-park option for guests willing to skip Magic Kingdom during the holiday rush.

parkioInsight.text: Christmas week tends to push Magic Kingdom to capacity by mid-morning. EPCOT and Animal Kingdom often remain more manageable for walk-ups and Lightning Lane availability through early afternoon.

bignews.title: Victoria and Albert's ranks top 10 in U.S., Jiko earns AAA Four Diamond
bignews.body: Victoria and Albert's at the Grand Floridian has been named one of the top ten restaurants in the United States, while Jiko at Animal Kingdom Lodge has regained its AAA Four Diamond designation alongside other recent Michelin recognitions.

parkioInsight.text: Award announcements often drive reservation surges within 48 hours. Check for cancellations during breakfast hours when guests adjust travel plans.

topstories.title: Tokyo Disneyland closes it's a small world in 2027
topstories.body: Tokyo Disneyland has scheduled a 2027 refurbishment for its version of it's a small world, adding to a growing closure list that also includes Tower of Terror at Tokyo DisneySea reopening in May.

parkioInsight.text: International park closures rarely affect U.S. operations, but Fantasyland at Disneyland tends to see spillover interest when Tokyo updates make headlines. Early mornings usually avoid the bump.

topstories.title: Disneyland security pavilion nears completion in Esplanade
topstories.body: The eastern half of the new security checkpoint in the Disneyland Resort Esplanade has opened, with fresh pavement and completed framework now visible after months of construction walls.

parkioInsight.text: New screening lanes often process guests faster during the break-in period as crowds adjust. Arriving before 8:30am on rope-drop days usually means minimal queue buildup.

topstories.title: Joe Rohde critiques prop changes in Expedition Everest queue
topstories.body: Imagineer Joe Rohde has publicly commented on recent alterations to props in the Expedition Everest queue at Animal Kingdom, calling certain changes problematic in terms of storytelling and authenticity.

parkioInsight.text: Queue details spark guest interest when designers comment publicly. Everest standby waits tend to climb mid-morning; rope-drop or evening rides usually offer shorter lines and better queue viewing.

topstories.title: Hexed merchandise launches ahead of November 25 theatrical release
topstories.body: Disney has released a full line of Hexed-branded products including hair color kits, nail polish, Funko Pop figures, and apparel ahead of the animated film's November 25 debut in theaters.

parkioInsight.text: Film-tie merchandise often sells out at flagship stores within the first weekend. World of Disney at Disney Springs and Emporium on Main Street usually restock mornings, but limited-edition items may not return.

topstories.title: Thanksgiving week crowds expected to reach historic levels
topstories.body: Travel forecasts, park reservation data, and Lightning Lane sellouts all point to Thanksgiving 2026 becoming one of the busiest holiday weeks in Disney World history, with Main Street gridlock likely throughout the period.

parkioInsight.text: Thanksgiving week historically sees capacity limits by 10am at Magic Kingdom. EPCOT and Animal Kingdom tend to remain more accessible, with better Lightning Lane inventory through early afternoon.

topstories.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party washed out by storms, guests receive gift cards
topstories.body: The November 19 edition of Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party was heavily impacted by weather, with no castle shows, one parade, and widespread disappointment prompting Disney to issue seventy-five dollar gift cards to attendees.

parkioInsight.text: November Florida storms tend to roll through between 7–9pm. Guests at evening events may want to monitor radar apps and plan indoor experiences or early exits when storms approach.

icymi.title: Hallmark holiday movie filmed at Walt Disney World premieres
icymi.body: Hallmark's first-ever Walt Disney World-set Christmas film, Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True, features cinematic celebrations shot across the resort during the holiday season.

icymi.title: Disney and Formula 1 extend partnership into 2026 season
icymi.body: Mickey and Friends return trackside for the 2026 Formula 1 race season as part of the multi-year Fuel the Magic partnership, building on last year's Las Vegas Grand Prix debut.

icymi.title: Droid Factory returns to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge
icymi.body: The classic build-your-own droid experience has reopened at Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge in both Hollywood Studios and Disneyland, allowing guests to assemble custom astromech units once again.

icymi.title: Saratoga Springs pool refurbishment added to 2027 calendar
icymi.body: Disney has scheduled a pool project at Saratoga Springs Resort for 2027, continuing construction work that has been underway at the property throughout this year.

spotlight.title: ShopRite offering twenty dollars back on hundred-dollar Disney gift card purchases
spotlight.body: ShopRite has launched a Black Friday promotion where customers who spend one hundred dollars on Disney gift cards receive twenty dollars back, joining other retailers offering pre-holiday discounts on park admission funding.

parkioInsight.text: Gift card promotions typically sell out within 72 hours of announcement. Stacking discounts with credit card rewards can often reduce effective ticket costs by fifteen to twenty percent for future visits.
